Description.name: Rare Flowah
Description.description: Tougher than a tree trunk and sturdier than a stump, Rare Flowah can take a trimming! But don't let its scratches and scrapes fool you, this botanical bruiser isn't getting in any fights. Instead, the klutzy Monster is bumping into walls! Hopefully its new top-knot will put an end to its flouncy petals obstructing its line of sight.
